newsitem.title: USA: Canada May spot gas rises 20-30 cts over April 1.
newsitem.headline: Canada May spot gas rises 20-30 cts over April 1.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices for May 1 carried a 20-30 cent premium to April 1 levels on Friday as most traders said they expected storage injections to escalate next month, market sources said.
May gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was talked at C$1.77-1.80 per gigajoule, up more than 25 cents from April indices. AECO prices for the weekend were mostly steady around C$1.76-1.77.
Canadian Gas Association said early Friday that western stocks were at 47.87 bcf, or 18.47 percent full, as of April 18. These data compare with 31.4 percent a year ago.
